description: Reads one live page the way an agent does, the free "What an agent reads" tool: robots.txt asked first, so a page closed to mttr is not fetched; then its main content as Markdown with words and an estimated token count (about 4 characters a token), and what helped or hurt the reading, each with a state and, where the rulebook has one, its rule: main text found, text before script runs or a shell a script fills in, one h1, headings as an outline, the answer under the first question, structured data and its types, and how much of the page is its own text. Read by mttr's crawler; an assistant's own reader may differ.

site.description: A whole site, as a domain such as example.com, from its latest read instead: the share of its pages an agent reads, how much of each is the page, where that stands among every site read, what its pages lose, its trend and rivals, and each AI crawler as its robots.txt treats it.

url.description: One page, as a full public address such as https://example.com/guides/a-page. Read live.

name: mttr_agent_view
title: See what an agent reads
